name: What should I consider regarding ventilation and exhaust for kitchen appliances during renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider regarding ventilation and exhaust for kitchen appliances during renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper ventilation is critical for kitchen appliances, particularly ranges and cooktops, to remove smoke, grease, and odors effectively. When planning a renovation, you need to consider the type of hood (ducted vs. ductless), its power (CFM), and the necessary ductwork. This impacts structural elements and ceiling/wall finishes. Frasheski Construction will assess your kitchen layout and appliance choices to design an optimal ventilation system, ensuring it meets local building codes and provides effective air quality in your home, especially important for open-plan living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider hood type, power, and ductwork for effective ventilation during renovation to remove smoke and odors, ensuring it meets local building codes.
